name: neither
description: Decision memory for Cursor via a local stdio MCP server (Node 20+). Tools return cited Decision / Rejected / Constraint / Citation, including supersession. Requires a workspace API key (NEITHER_API_KEY).

NEITHER_API_KEY.title: Neither API key
NEITHER_API_KEY.description: Workspace key (sk_ctx_…) from https://www.neither.online/developers/quickstart. Required. Set under Plugins → Configure. Do not commit the key.
